title: Artifacts: The Harmonic Sheet and the Sextic Orbit
description: Computational artifacts for the paper: the exact canonical model over F(sqrt(-23)) of one of the six non-rational M23 Hurwitz points of type (2A,23A,23B), its exact verification (V1)-(V8) in PARI/GP, the eight-point certificate (V9)-(V10) that the degree-23 map has exactly three branch points (an exact plane relation H_0(tau,U)=0 of bidegree (5,23) and the exact factorization H_0(b,U) = q_7 d_8^2), the exact characteristic-13 model with its Petri value, the sextic field receipts, and the characteristic-13 and characteristic-23 certificates of Parts I and II. The project made extensive, fully disclosed use of AI systems (Claude, Anthropic; ChatGPT, OpenAI) for exploration, code, computation, analysis and drafting under the author's direction; AI-generated suggestions were not treated as mathematical evidence, and every computational claim carries a reproducible artifact.
